label: sec:substrate-from-leptons-intro
html: Because leptons carry no strong colour-binding corrections, the charged-lepton mass ratios provide the cleanest empirical determination of the substrate modulus q_0 (\mathrm{CAL\text{-}2}). This section states the epistemic discipline governing the three calibrations, analyzes the two structural readings of the small \mu–p two-pin residual, derives the q-deformed skein mass relation, and cross-checks the hyperbolic volumes of the building-block knots against high-precision SnapPy triangulations.
